Arc Light Bureau

English Translation - v1.12.3en1

For Starsector 0.98a-RC8

Home for the wanderers from another world.

Source code

Adding to an ongoing game:

New game recommended

Updating:

Delete the previous Arc Light Bureau folder before installing the new version

Removing from an ongoing game:

Not safe

What is this?

Arc Light Bureau is a Chinese faction mod by

Hanliu

, previously known as

Traverser Design Bureau

.

This release uses the previous

English translation of Traverser Design Bureau

by

Mycophobia and Miko

as its base and updates it for the latest

Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3

, with permission.

Arc Light Bureau is a high-tech military-industrial faction focused on powerful shields and long-range firepower. It includes its own star system, ships, weapons, fighter wings, characters, missions, hullmods, ship systems, and campaign content.

A complete faction with its own star system, markets, fleets, characters, and campaign content.A large roster of ships, including conventional and automated vessels.Faction-specific weapons and fighters with their own combat roles.Unique ship systems and hullmods, including mechanics that allow some ships to change their combat role.Strong shields and long-range firepower are central to the faction's overall combat style.

BackgroundRising to prominence after the Collapse, the Bureau survived the AI Wars through a combination of political maneuvering and technological superiority. Its outward compliance with restrictions on artificial intelligence has done little to quiet suspicions surrounding the organization's research programs.

Today, relations between the Arc Light Bureau, the Hegemony, and the Luddic Church remain tense. Meanwhile, the Bureau continues to supply carefully selected clients with elegant and extremely lethal weapons of war.

Their ships generally combine powerful shields with relatively light armor and favor long-range engagements. Many vessels can also alter their combat role through unique built-in hullmod mechanics.

[close]

Some previews

Ship preview

A selection of ships available from the Arc Light Bureau.[close]

Installation

See

Adding mods to your game: first steps

Download and extract the archive.Place the ArcLightBureau folder inside your Starsector mods folder.Install LazyLib, MagicLib, and GraphicsLib.BoxUtil is optional but strongly recommended, as a number of visual effects and features make use of it.Enable Arc Light Bureau in the Starsector launcher.

Updating:

Delete the previous Arc Light Bureau folder first. Do not extract a new version over an existing installation.

If you still have an old version of

Traverser Design Bureau

installed, do not enable both mods at the same time.

Known compatibility issues:

Random Sector is not recommended. Some faction-specific structures and content may not generate correctly, which can make certain ships or other content unavailable.

FAQ

Is this the same mod as Traverser Design Bureau?

Yes. Arc Light Bureau is the new name of Traverser Design Bureau. This release updates the previous English translation for the latest Chinese version of the mod.

Can I use this with the old Traverser Design Bureau?

No. If you still have the old Traverser Design Bureau installed, do not enable both mods at the same time.

Can I add Arc Light Bureau to an existing save?

A new game is recommended.

Can I remove Arc Light Bureau from an ongoing save?

No. Removing the mod from an ongoing game is not considered safe.

Is BoxUtil required?

No, but it is strongly recommended because a number of the mod's visual effects and features use it.[close]

What is this?

Arc Light Bureau is a Chinese faction mod by Hanliu, previously known as Traverser Design Bureau.

This release uses the previous English translation of Traverser Design Bureau by Mycophobia and Miko as its base and updates it for the latest Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3, with permission.

Arc Light Bureau is a high-tech military-industrial faction focused on powerful shields and long-range firepower. It includes its own star system, ships, weapons, fighter wings, characters, missions, hullmods, ship systems, and campaign content.

  • A complete faction with its own star system, markets, fleets, characters, and campaign content.
  • A large roster of ships, including conventional and automated vessels.
  • Faction-specific weapons and fighters with their own combat roles.
  • Unique ship systems and hullmods, including mechanics that allow some ships to change their combat role.
  • Strong shields and long-range firepower are central to the faction's overall combat style.

BackgroundRising to prominence after the Collapse, the Bureau survived the AI Wars through a combination of political maneuvering and technological superiority. Its outward compliance with restrictions on artificial intelligence has done little to quiet suspicions surrounding the organization's research programs.

Today, relations between the Arc Light Bureau, the Hegemony, and the Luddic Church remain tense. Meanwhile, the Bureau continues to supply carefully selected clients with elegant and extremely lethal weapons of war.

Their ships generally combine powerful shields with relatively light armor and favor long-range engagements. Many vessels can also alter their combat role through unique built-in hullmod mechanics.
[close]
Some previews

Ship preview

A selection of ships available from the Arc Light Bureau.[close]
Installation

See Adding mods to your game: first steps

  • Download and extract the archive.
  • Place the ArcLightBureau folder inside your Starsector mods folder.
  • Install LazyLib, MagicLib, and GraphicsLib.
  • BoxUtil is optional but strongly recommended, as a number of visual effects and features make use of it.
  • Enable Arc Light Bureau in the Starsector launcher.

Updating: Delete the previous Arc Light Bureau folder first. Do not extract a new version over an existing installation.

If you still have an old version of Traverser Design Bureau installed, do not enable both mods at the same time.

Known compatibility issues: Random Sector is not recommended. Some faction-specific structures and content may not generate correctly, which can make certain ships or other content unavailable.

FAQIs this the same mod as Traverser Design Bureau?Yes. Arc Light Bureau is the new name of Traverser Design Bureau. This release updates the previous English translation for the latest Chinese version of the mod.

Can I use this with the old Traverser Design Bureau?No. If you still have the old Traverser Design Bureau installed, do not enable both mods at the same time.

Can I add Arc Light Bureau to an existing save?A new game is recommended.

Can I remove Arc Light Bureau from an ongoing save?No. Removing the mod from an ongoing game is not considered safe.

Is BoxUtil required?No, but it is strongly recommended because a number of the mod's visual effects and features use it.[close]
